about: The reviewed DeepInfra model rows of the preview spending gate (contract A section 1). The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py) and the app (packages/providers/src) must both equal this file; a price change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. Prices are list prices in USD per million tokens. efforts is the reviewed thinking-level menu (spec 2026-10-12 section 4.1): a request's level must be on it, "default" meaning the request carries no reasoning_effort field (None in the gate's row) and any other word meaning reasoning_effort exactly that word; its first entry is the level the app sends by default (today's request). A menu change is a reviewed row change on both sides and in this file. sampling null means the request carries none of temperature, top_p and top_k; a sampling object means it carries exactly those keys with exactly those values (reviewed 2026-10-12: Qwen3.8-Flash degenerated into random multilingual tokens at DeepInfra's defaults, so it runs at its makers' thinking-mode settings; MiMo-V2.6-Pro broke its JSON with a straight closing quote, so it runs at DeepInfra's recommended temperature 1.0 and top_p 0.95; its JSON mode, tried the same day, was withdrawn because DeepInfra's JSON constraint turned that slip into garbage the engine's reader could otherwise repair). Per-call caps (owner ruling 2026-10-10), the same for every row: output_bound (the max_tokens ceiling and the reservation's output term) 32768 tokens, and a hard request body cap of 256 KiB (worst_case_request_bytes; story requests reach about 236 KiB at the high story size).

reservation.formula: ((request utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes) * input price + output_bound * output price) / 1000000

final_writer.about: Length guidance LG-B (L26, L29, owner answer 4, 2026-10-15): the final-writer tier (answer writer, answer checker, storyteller, story checker). A request whose body is over 262144 bytes or whose max_tokens is over the row's output_bound is a final writer's: at most request_bytes, max_tokens at most the row's own output_bound below, and a full-size request reserves ((request_bytes + overhead_bytes) * input + output_bound * output) / 1000000 at most per_call_cap_usd. Each output_bound is the vendor's own maximum output (DeepInfra's max_output_tokens, read 2026-10-15; MiMo lists none: 65536). The gate (preview_budget_helper.py ModelRow.final_writer_output_bound, DeepInfraProfile.final_writer_*) and the app (preview-models.ts finalWriterOutputBound, PREVIEW_CALL_TIER_LIMITS) must both equal this member.
